display_long_description:
# Welcome to the Coziest Chaos in VR

Where bobbles meet, chill, and gear up before diving into unpredictable mini-games! 

# Explore the Island

Your snowy village hub packed with secret collectibles, dark caves, climbing towers, and sneaky little Cogloos to chase.
Hang out with friends, chat, and spam emotes while showing off your style as you queue for the next mini-game.

[media]

# Drop into Wild Mini-Games

**Maze** – Outrun the Monster. Push everyone off. Find the exit (or die trying).

**Jurassic** – Hunters team up to blast Team Dinos. Pure panic.

**Snowfight** – Shrinking zone. Snowball mayhem. Only one bobble survives.

[media]

# Cook Your Look

Win games and get gold. Or find hidden collectibles and trade for gold. Then equip the most unhinged accessories in VR. Yes even Skibidi toilets and bananas!
[media]
